blockers.detail: The exact canonical FinQA flan target file expected at src/Data_Target_Module/lora_flan_retriever/output/best_matched_with_retrieved_facts_and_questions_flan_promptpg.json is still missing, although nearby variants exist.

The exact canonical Apollo processed test CSV expected at src/Data_Target_Module/Apollo/output/best_matched_with_retrieved_facts_and_questions_apollo_promptpg_processed_data_test.csv is still missing, although nearby JSON artifacts exist.
The deleted active-repo FinFlier copy is not a runtime source; use docs/code/FinFlier/system as a read-only reference and require a new implementation plus smoke evidence before any runnable claim.
Future baselines such as FinQANet must be added under docs/code/<Name> and registered across governance files before use.
Formal Experiment 7 Target Answer Computation requires a completed GPT-5.5 selection_cache.json; similarity fallback is smoke-only.
vLLM, llama.cpp, and ChatMock should be started in tmux sessions named vllm, llama_cpp, and chatmock, then stopped or explicitly retained according to cleanup flags.
